text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Nice Nature—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that... a Paka Petit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, um, you see... They added new 
prizes to that claw machine over there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Nice Nature 
pointed, there was a claw crane game 
filled with plushies modeled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The other day I saw the same one displayed 
at a shop in the shopping district, and I 
was impressed by how popular it is.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It just caught my eye for a second, that's 
all. Cute stuff isn't really my style 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, no, no, it's totally fine!
choice_data_list: I'm the one who wants to get it.
I'm the one who wants to take it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you'd go that far? You sure are an 
eccentric, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll be watching from here. Do 
your best~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
